mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0% for three consecutive months, it indicates restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and suppresses corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% for 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in nonfarm payrolls and decrease in unemployment rate signals a robust labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 0.5% MoM and UNRATE decreases > 0.1pp MoM
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS increases > 0.5% MoM and UNRATE decreases > 0.1pp MoM, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand that precedes corporate earnings slowdowns, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods during late-cycle expansions when RSAFS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity that correlates with stronger corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it indicates a deteriorating labor market that suppresses consumer demand and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5% for 2 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales and housing starts signals robust consumer and housing demand that supports economic growth and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 0.3% MoM and HOUST increases > 0.5% MoM
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS increases > 0.3% MoM and HOUST increases > 0.5% MoM, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%), a month-over-month increase in the consumer price index indicates persistent inflation that triggers further monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 5.0% and CPIAUCSL increases MoM, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
